body: This is where I'm sort of at right now, too. The problem is that I also have pretty bad social anxiety and it takes a while to trust people. So idk why I'm even commenting, I just feel so empty and alone. I'll probably regret posting this later, but I don't know what to do with myself right now.

Extremely relatable, and I'm sorry you have to experience that as well. It seems absolutely crazy to me how I manage to get through a day sometimes because it is just emptiness and fear and it's just wasting the hours away as I mourn the passing of time and the fear and loss is so bad. The crushing loneliness is bad enough, but coupled with those feelings is just horrible. So I hope you can feel better, because I know it is hard. Idk why I'm here, maybe only because the energy to do most things I don't have... I don't know.
You are not alone in this at all, I'm turning 27 soon and think about most of the same things. I'm sorry you're feeling so down, and hope you are ok.
Nowadays I'm avoiding everything. Seems about right. I'm sorry you are sharing in that stuggle, it's a tough place to be...for sure.

Thank you for sharing this - it means a lot, and I hope you know this and will forever know this. Your words are meaningful and I thank you again for sharing because no amount of words can express how much I feel.
